title: Atomic Gradient Flows: Gradient Flows on Sparse Representations
summary: One of the most popular approaches for solving total variation-regularized optimization problems in the space of measures are Particle Gradient Flows (PGFs). These restrict the problem to linear combinations of Dirac deltas and then perform a Euclidean gradient flow in the weights and positions, significantly reducing the computational cost while still decreasing the energy. In this work, we generalize PGFs to convex optimization problems in arbitrary Banach spaces, which we call Atomic Gradient Flows (AGFs). To this end, the crucial ingredient turns out to be the right notion of particles,…
